purpose: Individual original-speed motion excerpts for the hero, Abstract, Method and Results. Source recordings and previous published derivatives are unchanged.
notes: G1 clips retain the exact previously reviewed source intervals from reports/media-revision.json.
No output contains an audio stream or source capture metadata.
Field clips are derived from the existing SDR/BT.709 silent rendering of the team’s self-recorded IMG_7082 (1).MOV.
G1 excerpts end before the later loss-of-balance or reset sequences and illustrate selected supervised movements rather than complete successful trials.
G1 clips are cropped to a window that follows the robot horizontally, never further left than the edge of the operator's position, so the operator stays out of frame. Source recordings are unchanged.
The opening is two silent videos of equal length side by side: three field excerpts on the left and two G1 excerpts on the right.

clips.title: Roofer at work
clips.caption: Opening film, left: a roofer at work on a pitched roof.
clips.description: A silent film of three shots at original speed, shown beside the robot. On an unfinished pitched roof, a worker carries a sheet of sheathing across the slope, bends over it with a handheld tool, and lowers into a deep crouch with both feet on the slope. Timber framing, neighboring houses, trees and sky are in view. This is field footage recorded by the research team.

clips.title: Opening film
clips.caption: Opening film, right: a G1 humanoid on a laboratory slope.
clips.description: A silent film of two shots at original speed, shown beside the roofer. In a laboratory, a Unitree G1 humanoid on a padded incline bends and lowers a handheld tool toward the pad, and in a separate trial bends deeply toward the surface. A safety tether is attached. The frame is cropped to follow the robot; the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot shots end before later motion, falls, or resets and do not show fastening.

clips.title: Incline walking
clips.caption: G1 steps onto the padded incline under a safety tether.
clips.description: In a portrait laboratory recording, a Unitree G1 robot moves from the floor onto a padded incline. The robot takes short steps and remains upright near the end of the selected movement. An overhead safety tether is attached. The frame is cropped to follow the robot; the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. This silent excerpt runs at original speed and ends before the later part of the trial; it does not show the complete outcome.

clips.title: Tool-reaching motion
clips.caption: G1 steps forward and bends with a tool toward the padded surface.
clips.description: In a laboratory, a Unitree G1 robot steps forward on a padded incline, bends its torso and lowers a handheld tool toward the padded surface, then begins to raise its torso. An overhead safety tether is attached. The frame is cropped to follow the robot; the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. This silent excerpt runs at original speed and ends before later motion or reset; it shows a selected movement, not a complete trial outcome or verified fastening.

clips.title: Bending toward the surface
clips.caption: G1 lowers its torso and tool toward the padded roof surface.
clips.description: In a separate laboratory trial, a Unitree G1 robot takes steps forward and bends deeply toward a padded incline, bringing its hand and handheld tool close to the surface. An overhead safety tether is attached. The frame is cropped to follow the robot; the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. This selected movement is shown at original speed without sound. The excerpt ends before later loss of balance and reset; it does not document the complete trial outcome, successful fastening or independent roofing work.

checks.fullFramesRetained: No. G1 clips and the opening film are cropped to the robot; field clips retain full frames.
